result.title: FluidGen: Physics-Aware Fluid Video Generation via Motion-Guided Post-Training
result.summary: Video generation models produce visually compelling motion but systematically fail on fluid phenomena, including smoke, fire, and explosion debris, where outputs lack coherent vortical structure and collapse to bland dynamics that violate the physics of real fluids. Classical solvers achieve high physical fidelity but require detailed 3D scenes and carefully tuned parameters, making them impractical for in-the-wild imagery and video generation. We address this gap by injecting a data-driven fluid prior into a pre-trained video model, trained on a mixture of high-fidelity Houdini simulation data with paired velocity-field ground truth and curated in-the-wild fluid video data for appearance diversity. The core of our approach is a dual stream architecture that predicts per-frame velocity fields alongside RGB, supervised by simulation ground truth. This auxiliary signal regularizes generation toward physically consistent motion and exposes an interpretable physical quantity that we further leverage as a reward for velocity-aware direct preference optimization. Our model produces substantially more realistic fluid dynamics sequences than strong video baselines and optimization-based methods. Project page: https://y-zheng18.github.io/FluidGen/

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 FluidGen，向预训练视频生成模型注入数据驱动的流体先验：用双流架构在生成 RGB 的同时预测逐帧速度场，并以 Houdini 模拟真值监督该物理隐量，再用速度感知的 DPO 作为奖励来正则化生成运动的物理一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 「观测 + 隐物理场」双流预测、用真值监督该隐量并将其作为偏好优化奖励的设计，可能为 VLM 推理中 latent 状态的辅助监督方式与贡献分配／奖励构造提供可核查的方法线索，但该工作在视频生成领域，联系需进一步确认。
